svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Wireframe: Start a migration, six screens
svg.desc: Who it is for, which accounts are left, what moves, connecting, where it goes, and one check-then-start screen.
svg.text: Start a migration: six screens (0153 T4), each starts at the top with focus on its heading
They connect their own accounts with a link;
None preselected. More than one can be ticked.
▸ Other ways to connect (IMAP, CalDAV, CardDAV,
▸ Not from Dropbox: mail, calendar, contacts
Asked before any consent, so each consent asks
for exactly what was ticked (T1 c).
One sign-in: mail, calendar, contacts, files
Photos need no sign-in: they come from
A saved account is offered first (0064). A greyed
button says why in text under it (0145 T7 a).
One consent per provider, for what was ticked.
Where Google’s restricted scopes are not declared,
mail and files sign in apart; the screen says so first.
Nextcloud: its address, e.g. cloud.example.org (T7 c)
About 4 to 5 days, because Google lets a
mailbox download 2.5 GB a day (0154 T3 a)
▸ What migrates, partly, and not (Google’s rows only)
I understand that 173 Google files will not
be copied in their own format
One review screen holds the green light (0013, 0037): nothing copies before Start. After it, the person’s page (T5). Underneath: one migration per pair of accounts.
